response.overview: The Flame of Szeged (A szegedi láng) is a 2016 Hungarian historical documentary directed by historian Dr. Lajos Forró and commissioned by the University of Szeged. The film chronicles the decisive role played by university and college students in Szeged during the 1956 Hungarian Revolution. Through archival footage and personal recollections from surviving eyewitnesses, it traces the formation of the independent student organization MEFESZ, which sparked the nationwide uprising against Soviet oppression.
response.title: A szegedi láng
